## Methods

### List

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`)

Method to get a list of metrics among which the collection of related metrics forms a metric family

```go
func (c *Client) List(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[*ListOut, error]
```

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | Metric family name, e.g. io.systemd.Manager.unitsByTypeTotal or io.systemd.Manager.unitActiveState |
| `object` | `?string` | Metric object name can be unit name, process name, etc, e.g. dev-hvc0.device |
| `fields` | `?object` | Metric fields are values to differentiate between different metrics in the same metric family |
| `value` | `any` | Metric value |

## Types

### MetricFamilyType

An enum representing various metric family types

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | A counter metric family type which is a monotonically increasing value |
| `gauge` | A gauge metric family type which is a value that can go up and down |
| `string` | A string metric family type |
| `object` | An object metric family type whose value is an arbitrary JSON object |
